sampling: Only register for original inflight completed-frame targets37055..39471; no coordinate/character/phase-based callback filtering. Read all hits, retaining raw registered trigger PC and separately observed CPU PC.
capability_limit: IGpgxHost Action wrapper discards the underlying callbackAddress parameter. registered_trigger_pc is exact checked registration address, not falsely labelled as a captured backend callbackAddress. Observed PC comes independently from ReadCpuRegister.
